scientific_integrity: Analytic proof for all stated dimensions and real one-sided inputs; exact-rational tests are corroboration, not an all-dimension proof. No earlier priority or independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only cut signals and all real signals supported on a single bipartition class are classified; full two-sided real BV norm, weighted variants and uncentered operators are not addressed. Full text of a plausible prior finite-graph variation source was unavailable.
title: Sharp cut-variation and one-sided rigidity for centered maximal averages on complete bipartite graphs
